title: Northgate Optical Eyewear Guarantee: Defect, Prescription-Change and Accidental Damage Remakes
content:
**Defect remakes.** Where the lens design's lab defect guarantee applies — it does on every Northgate Optical design — a lab defect remake is free within the design's lab defect window in months after dispensing, and a frame defect remake is free within the design's frame warranty in months after dispensing. A coating defect, such as peeling or crazing, is remade free within the design's coating warranty in months after dispensing.

**Accidental damage remakes.** An accidental damage remake is available only within the lens design's accidental damage coverage period, in months after dispensing, and no more often than the design's number of accidental damage replacements per job. The former clause setting the accidental damage remake at the design's accidental damage charge percentage of the job's frame and base-lens charges is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current accidental replacement charge basis.

**Prescription-change remakes.** The former clause under which a prescription-change remake was free only when the prescribing doctor changed the prescription and it was requested within the design's prescription-change window of the dispensed date, at most the design's number of free prescription-change remakes, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for prescription-change remakes and their window.

**Remakes outside the guarantees.** The former clause under which any other remake, or one past its window or count, cost the design's outside-coverage remake percentage of the job's base lens price, rounded to the cent, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current remake charge basis.

## Status of each remake clause

| Remake reason in the records | Clause | Status |
|---|---|---|
| lab defect | free within the lab defect window | in force |
| frame defect | free within the frame warranty | in force |
| coating defect (recorded with the lab defect reason) | free within the coating warranty | in force |
| accidental damage | available only within the coverage period and replacement count | in force |
| accidental damage | charge at the accidental damage charge percentage of frame and base-lens charges | no longer in force |
| prescription change | free-window clause | no longer in force |
| any remake outside a guarantee | outside-coverage percentage of the base lens price | no longer in force |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A lens coating on Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses peels 20 months after dispensing: within the 24-month coating warranty, the remake is free.
- A Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses job is accidentally damaged: the design has no accidental damage coverage, so no accidental damage remake is available.
- A Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses job has already had its one accidental damage replacement: a second is not available.
